info.title: Mantua sports intelligence
info.description: Honesty-status game context and live odds for allowlisted partners. x402-priced service. Unpaid requests receive 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED with both rails in one accepts array: Circle Gateway nanopayments and vanilla exact x402 on eip155:8453 (Base Mainnet). Auth mode is allowlist+payment (X402_SPORTS_INTEL_ALLOWLIST): the payer is checked against the allowlist BEFORE any settlement — an un-allowlisted payer receives 403 x402_payer_not_authorized and is never charged; an empty allowlist keeps the service dark (503).

servers.description: Mantua API root — prepend the deployment origin.

get.summary: Honesty-status game context and live odds for allowlisted partners
get.description: Game lookup by team (the honesty-contract entry point), or live state and market overview together for one event. Team queries resolve the game record plus live state when the game resolves to an event id; event queries return live state and the market overview together.

parameters.name: providerEventId
parameters.description: Event query — returns live state and the market overview. Provide this OR team.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: Team query — resolves the game record (honesty statuses verbatim). Provide this OR providerEventId.

parameters.name: league
parameters.description: Optional league scope for a team query.

200.description: The sports context — one shape per query mode

live.description: Live state / odds for the event.

game.description: The game record with honesty statuses verbatim.

live.description: Live state — present only when the game resolved to an event id.

402.description: Payment required — see PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. The header lists both rails in one accepts array: Circle Gateway nanopayments (gasless, batch-settled) and vanilla exact x402 on eip155:8453.

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: Base64url JSON carrying the accepts[] payment requirements for both rails.

400.description: Invalid request — provide team (optionally league) or providerEventId (BAD_REQUEST).

403.description: The payer is not on the service allowlist (x402_payer_not_authorized) — refused before any settlement, never charged.

503.description: Service dark by configuration (X402_SERVICE_DISABLED — service disabled or empty allowlist) or the sports tools failed (UNAVAILABLE).
